_about: Batch B5b (sliding window, KV compression, cross-layer sharing, YOCO). Owner: writer B5b.

ring-buffer.short: A fixed number of slots that the code uses again in a circle. Position p goes to slot p % size, so a new entry replaces the oldest one.
ring-buffer.long: DeepInfer's sliding-window cache is a ring per sequence and layer: state_id × size + pos % size ({{cite csrc/engine/input_metadata/prepare_tensor_input_v4.cpp:104}}).

backtracking-tokens.short: Extra ring slots for the tokens that one decode step can add and later take back (draft tokens). Default: DEEPINFER_USE_NEXTN_DECODE + 1 = 6.
backtracking-tokens.long: DEEPINFER_MAX_BACKTRACKING_TOKENS is raised to at least DEEPINFER_USE_NEXTN_DECODE + 1 ({{cite deepinfer/environ.py:132}}).

swa-pivots.short: Four int32 numbers per prefill query: start and length of its window keys in the history section, then in the new-token section of one gathered buffer.
swa-pivots.long: Made in C++ ({{cite csrc/engine/input_metadata/prepare_tensor_input_v4.cpp:487-527}}) and expanded by expand_swa_index ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/layers/tilelang_ops/swa_index.py:10-32}}).

compression-state.short: A small fp32 ring per sequence for a C2 layer. It keeps the score and latent of recent tokens, so a token can wait for the second token of its pair.

compressed-entry.short: One 512-value row of the main paged cache (ca_cache). It holds one token (C1) or a weighted mix of 2 tokens (C2).
compressed-entry.long: Stored as 288 B (FP4) or 528 B (FP8) per entry ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/layers/tilelang_ops/cache_common.py:109-128}}).

cross-layer-sharing.short: A layer reads the compressed KV, the indexer keys or the top-k list of an earlier source layer, and does not store its own copy.

source-layer.short: In cross-layer sharing, the layer that computes and stores a value. The layers after it in the same segment (its consumers) read that value.
source-layer.long: A source maps to itself: layer_map[l] == l ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/cross_layer.py:263-270}}).

cross-layer-runtime.short: One object per forward that carries values from a source layer to later layers: pre-RoPE KV, top-k list, loaded prefill buffers, YOCO data.

yoco.short: DeepInfer's name for the split of the main layers into producer layers and consumer layers. Consumer layers make their compressed KV from one shared hidden state.
yoco.long: Consumer layers are [n_prefill_layer, N) ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/yoco.py:19-21}}). The docs call the two halves encoder and decoder layers ({{cite doc/inference_deployment_qa.md:187}}).

shared-hidden.short: The attention-norm output of the first YOCO consumer layer. KV-source consumer layers project their compressed KV from it.

swa-bounded-replay.short: A prefill computes the YOCO consumer layers only for the last KEEP_TOKENS prompt tokens, with the window cut at that range. The consumer-layer SWA KV is then approximate (a deduction; the deployment notes agree).
swa-bounded-replay.long: Mode DEEPINFER_YOCO_PREFILL_TRUNCATION_MODE ({{cite deepinfer/environ.py:188-194}}); README setting: compact and 140 ({{cite README.md:25}}).
